description: Check the zip for unsafe files, then redeploy the live Worker. Flat $0.50 per edit on every rail (x402 wallet or card/PromptPay payment_url). Does not extend lease days. Ownership: a site claimed with a wallet must be edited by paying from that same wallet; a site paid by card/PromptPay needs its editToken (shown once at claim and emailed to the payer). If you have no wallet, get payment_url from the 402 response and show it to the human — they pay by card or Thai PromptPay in THB (no crypto needed); after they pay, poll preview_status/retry until live.

editToken.description: Edit token of a site paid by card/PromptPay (shown once at claim and emailed to the payer). Required to edit/renew/connect a domain on such a site.
